rows.label: tlk70000063_01_msg0001
rows.name:
Oh, everyone. Have you come to hear my
theory about ether miasma again?

rows.label: tlk70000063_01_msg0002
rows.name:
Of course. I'd especially like the
Blades among you, who can freely
control ether flow, to hear it.

rows.label: tlk70000063_01_msg0003
rows.name:
Well then... Ahem. Ether miasma seems
to be a kind of waste discharged by
Divine Beasts.

rows.label: tlk70000063_01_msg0004
rows.name:
So to remove it, it's important to
restore the ether flow around the
miasma to normal. Yes.

rows.label: tlk70000063_01_msg0005
rows.name:
Then the Divine Beast's self-purifying
ability should naturally disperse the
miasma into the air.

rows.label: tlk70000063_01_msg0006
rows.name:
Simply put, manipulating ether is
essential to clearing ether miasma.
Yes.

rows.label: tlk70000063_01_msg0007
rows.name:
And that's how it works. Come back
anytime you'd like to hear it again.
Yes.
